about: Lane RB-I0: the engine-2 images (the *-e2 envs) on the same tg_poll budget. Rows here carry "engine": 2, so they are checked only on an engine-2 image, and the engine-1 rows (no "engine", default 1) only on an engine-1 image. The floor is the same 4,096 B (PRD section 10: at least 4,096 B on engine 2, target 6,000 B). RB-I1/RB-I2 add the engine's own paths (turn, head round, tool calls, compaction) when they bind it.

paths.name: engine 2: a message answered (the stub seam's handleMessage)
paths._why: orchOnMessage -> the engine seam's handleMessage: on the RB-I0 stub the history rows and the fixed line's delivery; RB-I1/RB-I2 replace it with the engine's turn
